name: Clementine Akizuki
original_name: クレメンタイン・秋月
source:
Class: Year 2, Lily Class

One of the Six Maidens who is known as the "Sunny Lady." She is a beautiful exchange student from Manzilmania University's affiliated school, located in the United States. Everyone calls her by her nickname "Clemy". Like her title suggests, she has a sunny disposition, and though she's relaxed most of the time, she gets very excited when talking about the things she likes.

She is fluent in Japanese, which she learnt through watching anime and reading manga, and she can also speak both French and German fluently. 

Before coming to Japan, she was looking forward to tasting Japanese food, only to be shocked how it was different from what she imagined.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1292095]Getchu[/url]]
